layout_structure.layout_description: The slide has a clean, white background with a large, simple title 'Overview' positioned at the top-left. The central portion of the slide is dominated by a detailed architectural flowchart that illustrates a neural network pipeline. This diagram begins on the left with two input images—a ground-level view and a satellite view—which pass through a shared 'Feature Extractor'. The core of the proposed method is highlighted in a large red-outlined box labeled 'T2GA', showing internal components like MLP layers, Softmax, and attention operations. To the right of this module, the data flows into a 'Baseline Model' box containing four sub-components: a Confidence Map Generator, Keypoint Detector, Weighted Residual Calculator, and Pose Optimizer. The pipeline terminates on the far right with three loss functions, two of which are highlighted in red boxes. Below the diagram, on the bottom-left, is a 'Contributions:' section with three bullet points. Each bullet point describes a specific part of the method, with key terms ('T2GA', 'CycDA', and 'Equidistant') highlighted in red to match the diagram's visual cues. The text density is moderate, focusing on visual representation of the system architecture.

layout_structure.layout_type: single column with title and diagram
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide features a large, centered diagram illustrating the 'CycDA Loss' architecture against a plain white background. A simple, black title is positioned at the top-left corner. The diagram itself is a structured flowchart with two parallel horizontal paths (top and bottom) connected by vertical double-headed arrows. The top path flows from left to right, starting with 'f_g', passing through a concatenation node 'c', an encoder 'E', a latent representation 'm_g', another concatenation node 'c', a decoder 'D', and ending at 'f_g2s'. The bottom path flows from right to left, starting with 'f_s', and follows a symmetric structure through 'c', 'E', 'm_s', 'c', and 'D' to reach 'f_s2g'. Three vertical double-headed arrows labeled 'L2 loss' connect corresponding nodes between the top and bottom paths: 'f_g' to 'f_s2g', 'm_g' to 'm_s', and 'f_g2s' to 'f_s'. Additional vertical arrows point from central labels 'c_g' and 'c_s' to the concatenation nodes in both paths. The overall text density is light, focusing primarily on the symbolic representation of the model's components and loss functions.
